overall_reason: At 375 the anchor rail keeps its desktop column and squeezes the article to about 163px, the page shows 29 characters without script, and the anchor titles are cut at their distinguishing words.

score.reason: T-WIDTHS fails at 375 (ROB-010, ROB-007), T-NO-SCRIPT fails on a docs page (ROB-015), T-TRUNCATION fails on the anchor rail (ROB-006) and T-WEIGHT-FOR-JOB fails on requests (ROB-018).

findings.title: The layout holds between and beyond the captured widths
findings.where: Article column beside div.ant-anchor, 375px, tiles/375-00.png and tiles/375-02.png
findings.evidence: At 375 the 'on this page' anchor rail stays in a right column (x about 225 to 375), so the article gets about 163px: parity records the Emphasis paragraph at 163px wide and 465px tall at 375 against 928px wide at 1440. The tiles show headings breaking at every word ('Common Button / Types'), bullets three words to a line and the demo images cut at the article's right edge. The stylesheet declares breakpoints at 575, 767 and 991px, and none hides the rail.
findings.before: The desktop three-column layout keeps its anchor rail on phones.
findings.after: Hide the anchor rail below 768px, or fold it into a collapsible 'On this page' control above the article.
findings.why: A phone reader gets a column narrower than half the screen, and the demos are cut off.
findings.root: anchor rail with no phone rule

findings.title: Short labels stay whole on one line
findings.where: 'Edit this page' and 'LLMs.md' links under the h1, 375px, tiles/375-00.png
findings.evidence: The tile shows 'Edit this page' broken one letter per line ('E d i t / t h i s / p a g e') and 'LLMs.md' as 'L L M s . m d' stacked, because the 163px column leaves each link a few pixels.
findings.before: Two short action links wrap letter by letter.
findings.after: Fix the column width (see ROB-010); keep the links on one line with white-space: nowrap once they have room.
findings.why: The two actions under the title read as a vertical string of letters.
findings.root: anchor rail with no phone rule

findings.title: Content and navigation do not depend on script
findings.evidence: resilience.hidden_content.scripts_off: 29 visible characters of 29 (0.6% of the 4535-character baseline); the sweep's hidden_content Floor (ROB-001) records it.
findings.before: A documentation page renders its text only from script.
findings.after: Pre-render the docs page to HTML (the site generator supports static export) and hydrate after.
findings.why: A reference page meant to be read is blank for anyone whose bundle fails, and for tools that read HTML.

findings.title: Wrap before truncating, and never truncate what matters
findings.evidence: text_risk.nowrap_clipped: 'How to Decide Button Placement?' clipped by 96px, 'When to Put Buttons in the Footer?' by 99px, 'Common Button Types' by 32px, 'Special Button Types' by 22px, 'Grouping Buttons' by 4px. The tile shows 'How to Decide...', 'When to Put B...', 'Grouping Butt...', 'Common Butto...' and 'Special Button...'.
findings.before: Anchor titles are cut to one line in a 118 to 195px rail.
findings.after: Let anchor titles wrap to two lines with a hanging indent.
findings.why: The cut removes the words that tell the sections apart ('Common Butto...' against 'Special Button...').

findings.title: Weight fits the page's job
findings.evidence: performance: 113 requests (fail), 2151 KiB known (warn), JS 853 KiB in 50 files (warn). The sweep's performance hits (WEB-001) record images 875px wide shown at 16px and 928px shown at 204px; the heaviest image is 242 KiB.
findings.before: A text docs page loads 50 script files and full-size images for 16px icons.
findings.after: Serve the icons and figures at their shown sizes and split the docs bundle per route.
findings.why: Reading one guideline page costs over 2 MB.

strengths: The kit uses logical properties throughout (1775 logical against 289 physical).
At 1280 and 1440 the article reads at a comfortable measure with the demos intact (tiles/1280-00.png).
Fonts use font-display: optional, so text never waits for a font.

right-to-left render: not captured; readiness read from the stylesheet only
page load on a throttled line: only actions were held slow
layout shift as a number: this capture predates CLS recording
computed text-overflow per element: absent in this capture; ellipsis rows come from class rules and were checked on tiles
widths between the captures, 320px and landscape
regions behind menus, tabs, dialogs or a login that the capture did not open

T-LOCALE-FORMAT: no dates, money or units found
